title: Freelancer Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native, Expo, TypeScript) m/w/d
description:
Willkommen bei easybill.

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Mit easybill-mobile bringen wir zentrale Funktionen unserer Plattform auf iOS und Android – und suchen dich, um die App technisch und produktseitig mitzugestalten.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen rund um Rechnungen und Dokumente in verständliche mobile Abläufe und hochwertige native Oberflächen.
  • Du entwickelst die App-Architektur weiter und schaffst wartbare Strukturen für Navigation, wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Formulare und Datenzugriffe.
  • Du bindest unsere REST-API an und sorgst für verlässliches Datenmanagement: von typisierten Schnittstellen und Validierung bis zu Caching, Ladezuständen und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen App und Backend. Bei Bedarf erweiterst du unsere REST-API auf Basis von PHP und Symfony, damit neue mobile Funktionen durchgängig umgesetzt werden können.
  • Du arbeitest an sicherer Authentifizierung, Session-Verwaltung und dem sorgfältigen Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden- und Geschäftsdaten.
  • Du behältst Performance und Plattformbesonderheiten im Blick – auch bei wechselnden Netzverbindungen, App-Wechseln und unterschiedlichen Geräten. Barrierefreiheit und Mehrsprachigkeit gehören für dich zur Produktqualität.
  • Du sicherst Änderungen mit automatisierten Tests und prüfst das Verhalten auf Simulatoren und echten Geräten. Du gestaltest Build-, Release- und Monitoring-Prozesse bis zur Veröffentlichung in den App Stores mit.
  • Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein und begleitest Funktionen von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code intensiv im Entwicklungsalltag und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Korrektheit der Ergebnisse.

Unser Mobile-Stack umfasst React Native, Expo, Expo Router und TypeScript. Dazu kommen TanStack Query und TanStack Form, Zod und NativeWind. Für Tests setzen wir auf Jest und React Native Testing Library. Unsere bestehende Plattform und die REST-API basieren auf PHP und Symfony.

Qualifikation

  • Du musst nicht jede Bibliothek bereits kennen. Entscheidend ist, dass du deinen Stack verstehst, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich selbstständig in neue Themen einarbeitest.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript, React Native und Expo auf Senior-Level und hast mobile Anwendungen über die reine Implementierung hinaus bis zum Release begleitet.
  • Du verstehst React, Komponentenarchitektur, Zustandsverwaltung und asynchrone Datenflüsse und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich strukturieren.
  • Du kennst die Besonderheiten von iOS und Android und gehst systematisch an Performance-Probleme, Plattformfehler und Debugging heran.
  • Du bist sicher in der Anbindung von REST-APIs und verstehst API-Verträge, Authentifizierung, Validierung und Fehlerbehandlung.
  • Idealerweise bringst du zusätzlich Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit. Du kannst bestehende API-Endpunkte verstehen, Fehler zwischen App und Backend analysieren und Schnittstellen eigenständig erweitern.
  • Automatisierte Tests, nachvollziehbare technische Entscheidungen und wartbarer Code gehören für dich zum Entwicklungsalltag.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch, kommunizierst klar und behältst den Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Blick.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrung mit EAS, nativen Modulen in Swift oder Kotlin sowie App-Store-Veröffentlichungen und mobilen Release-Prozessen. Auch eigene veröffentlichte Apps, Open-Source-Beiträge oder öffentliche Experimente auf GitHub sind willkommen.

Wenn du nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllst, aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast. Zeig uns, was du gebaut hast!

Benefits

  • Remote-First Team – keine Bindung an einen Standort
  • Eine inspirierende und flexible Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung basiert
  • Die Möglichkeit, an der Gestaltung der Unternehmensstrategie und -kultur mitzuwirken
  • Ein engagiertes Team und die Chance, gemeinsam an innovativen Lösungen zu arbeiten
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents

Du möchtest easybill auf iOS und Android mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Besonders interessieren uns Projekte, bei denen du technische Verantwortung übernommen hast: Was hast du gebaut, welche Entscheidungen hast du getroffen und was hast du dabei gelernt?

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Senior iOS Engineer, Guest & Host
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The App Experience & Frameworks team’s mission is to empower product teams at Airbnb to build high-quality experiences by providing the feature foundations and unified app wide product frameworks. The Senior iOS Engineer joining this team will play a critical role in the end-to-end development of new product features across guest and host experiences, driving features from prototypes to production launch in collaboration with cross-functional partners across Design, Product, Marketing, Data Science and partner Engineering teams.

This team is part of the App Foundation organization, focusing on building common solutions for Tech-wide priorities like Performance, Event Logging, App Configuration (AirParam), and builds app-wide features and frameworks including Host Task System, Navigation, and the Early Access Program.

The Difference You Will Make:

  • As a Senior iOS Engineer on the App Experience & Frameworks team, you will build features and frameworks that enhance the app experience for millions of guests and hosts. You will work on horizontal product concerns such as app navigation, announcement scheduling, frameworks that power host required actions, and more, to lay the product foundation for bringing a more unified customer experience across platforms.
  • Success in this role looks like shipping reliable, scalable, and polished iOS experiences that both bring direct customer delight and enable feature teams to build and experiment faster.

A Typical Day:

  • Collaborate closely with cross functional partners in Design and Product to rapidly ideate, prototype, develop, and ship both product features and app wide frameworks.
  • Develop prototypes to validate ideas while proactively considering long-term implications on technical design and architecture.
  • Translate prototypes to high quality, scalable, and maintainable production code through iterative development.
  • Partner with peer engineering teams to integrate new features that impact different areas within the product and continuously optimize frameworks the team owns based on developer feedback.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve bugs, accessibility, and globalization issues affecting the iOS app.

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of building production iOS applications at scale.
  • Expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit, as well as deep understanding of client architecture and UI performance.
  • Experience working with backend and other platform (Android and web) engineers to integrate APIs and keep cross-platform experiences consistent.
  • Bias toward action in ambiguous situations, with ability to independently lead projects from start to finish.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills. Flexible and resilient when scope, designs, and priorities change, treating iterations as a path to better product rather than a setback.
  • Attention to detail and a high bar for polish, accessibility, and quality.
  • Preferably with prior experience shipping delightful user experiences that include fluid interactions, motion, and graphics.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$196,000—$227,000 USD

  • Design and implement scalable iOS application architecture that supports advanced crypto trading experiences used by Robinhood's most active investors
  • Partner with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data teams to deliver fast, reliable, and intuitive pro-grade trading tools on mobile
  • Improve application performance, real-time data handling, observability, and release stability across core crypto trading workflows
  • Lead technical planning and provide guidance during system design reviews, implementation discussions, and incident resolution efforts for high-stakes trading features
  • Mentor iOS engineers through code reviews, technical feedback, and structured development support while contributing to engineering standards and documentation

What you bring

  • Extensive experience building and maintaining large-scale iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS development frameworks
  • Experience designing mobile systems with clear architecture patterns, scalable component design, and maintainable testing strategies — particularly for data-intensive or real-time use cases
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, backend, and infrastructure partners to deliver customer-focused technical solutions
  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams and balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term platform improvements
  • Experience working on financial platforms, trading systems, or real-time market data products (preferred)
  • Clear communication skills and ability to translate complex trading concepts into intuitive mobile experiences
  • This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits

description:
About the Team

The ChatGPT organization at OpenAI supports our mission by building products that bring cutting-edge AI capabilities to hundreds of millions of users worldwide. The Image Generation team is responsible for one of the fastest-growing experiences in ChatGPT, enabling users to create, edit, and transform images through natural language. Recent advances in our multimodal models have dramatically improved image quality, instruction following, editing precision, consistency, and text rendering, unlocking entirely new creative and professional workflows.

We work at the intersection of research and product, partnering closely with researchers, designers, product managers, and platform engineers to bring state-of-the-art image generation capabilities to life across ChatGPT and our mobile applications. Millions of users rely on these experiences every day to create, communicate, learn, and build.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Android Software Engineer to build and improve image generation experiences within the ChatGPT Android app.

You will help define how users create, edit, and interact with visual content powered by the latest multimodal AI models. This is an opportunity to work on a highly visible product area, translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into intuitive, performant, and delightful mobile experiences used by millions around the world. ChatGPT's Android app already enables users to generate and transform images directly from their devices, and we're just getting started.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and ship new Android features that power image generation and image editing experiences.

  • Create intuitive user experiences that make advanced AI capabilities feel seamless and accessible.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Research, and Engineering teams to bring new multimodal capabilities to production.

  • Drive improvements in app performance, reliability, architecture, testing, and developer tooling.

  • Optimize media-heavy workflows, rendering performance, networking, and responsiveness across a wide range of Android devices.

  • Own projects end-to-end—from ideation and implementation through launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Help shape the future of AI-powered creativity on mobile.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have deep experience building Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android development frameworks.

  • Have shipped consumer-facing mobile products at scale and care deeply about performance, quality, and user experience.

  • Enjoy working on highly cross-functional teams and collaborating closely with product, design, and research partners.

  • Are excited by multimodal AI and the opportunity to bring cutting-edge image generation technology to millions of users.

  • Have experience building media-rich, graphics-intensive, camera, photo, video, or creative tooling applications.

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments where you can help define both the product and technical direction.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
